steps.expected_verification_and_frozen_boundar: JSON/IDs/paths/units/status/source hashes and unchanged old projects; freeze this design record with pending values explicit

steps.name: Data & Integration Contracts
steps.acceptance_gate: 01; resolve/version O1/O2 and map every source field/gap. Define schema IDs and unit-bearing fields for input/jobs/cranes/bays, geometry/rate provenance, plan/path/events/outcomes/KPIs, immutable observation/proposal and integration rejection contracts. All references/units/version rules and approximation metadata unambiguous; adapter feasibility honest
steps.expected_verification_and_frozen_boundar: Schema/identity/unknown-field/invalid-unit/round-trip design fixtures, no executable scheduling; freeze schema versions, source mapping and decisions with unresolved numerics marked; actual adapter execution waits for 13
steps.excluded: Generator, physical kernel, policies, optimizer, environment, training, integration execution

steps.name: Synthetic Scenario Generator
steps.acceptance_gate: 02, accepted O3 parameter profile; deterministic labeled standalone supported instances, independent bay/job/move counts and original IDs; split namespace/fingerprint separation and categorical coverage
steps.expected_verification_and_frozen_boundar: Same config/seed -> identical bytes/fingerprint; invalid/impossible and zero-work fixtures labeled; freeze generator/profile/split manifests with sample sizes reviewed
steps.excluded: Scheduling algorithms, solver, PPO; no inherited empirical calibration claim

steps.name: Physical Scheduling Core
steps.acceptance_gate: 02–03, accepted O1–O3 motion/geometry/timing; single clock, path reservations, setup/process, deterministic events, replayable state/trace and independent validator; every physical/completion invariant implemented
steps.expected_verification_and_frozen_boundar: All INV01–14 applicable cases, X1/X2, simultaneous events, continuity/speed/conservation, deadlock/horizon/empty input, property checks; freeze core/validator/numeric/trace versions
steps.excluded: Policy optimization, CP-SAT, training, real-terminal safety certification

steps.name: Heuristic Baselines
steps.acceptance_gate: 04; four distinct deterministic safe policies described in scientific contract, legal WAIT and honest coverage/unsupported handling
steps.expected_verification_and_frozen_boundar: Same input -> identical valid plan; verify constructive stratum and failures; validator rejects malicious paths; freeze policy IDs/configs, tie rules and supported action space

steps.name: CP-SAT Reference Solver
steps.acceptance_gate: 04–05 plus O4; bounded small-instance model, status/bounds/gaps, approximation and continuous path validation; optimal only with matching certification
steps.expected_verification_and_frozen_boundar: Hand-solvable cases, infeasible/unknown/time-limit incumbent, integer scaling/rounding and error bounds, model/validator agreement; freeze solver/formulation/grid/budget versions
steps.excluded: Claiming unrestricted continuous optimality without proof, large campaign, RL

steps.name: Baseline Benchmark
steps.acceptance_gate: 03–06; common frozen inputs/physics/validator/metrics and controlled comparison of four heuristics/reference; predeclare family weights/counts/contrasts/inference before test access
steps.expected_verification_and_frozen_boundar: Pairing/source/environment hashes, failure coverage, runtime accounting, split audits, reproducibility records; freeze baseline protocol/test manifests/results before RL test use
steps.excluded: Training, outcomes-based test reselection, commercial ranking

steps.name: Dynamic Crane Environment
steps.acceptance_gate: 04–07; reviewed causal event-driven interface and termination/WAIT semantics on v1; any genuinely dynamic diagnostic uses a separately declared extension
steps.expected_verification_and_frozen_boundar: Observable-state/hidden-future mutation, time progress, no competing clock, deterministic reset/termination/truncation; freeze environment event/visibility version after review
steps.excluded: PPO training, premature final tensor/action architecture, multi-vessel/QCAP creep

steps.name: RL Observation & Action Design
steps.acceptance_gate: 08; review stable crane/task slots, M/overflow, scales, masks/action grammar including yielding, elapsed reward/failure bound, discount/truncation semantics
steps.expected_verification_and_frozen_boundar: Space/dtype/shape and slot stability, masks agree with validator, finite same-time decisions, WAIT anti-stall, telescoping objective tests; freeze observation/action/reward and preprocessing versions
steps.excluded: Training/checkpoint selection or monolithic berth+crane+yard RL

steps.name: Maskable PPO Training

steps.expected_verification_and_frozen_boundar: Split disjointness, checkpoint sidecar/space compatibility, deterministic evaluation mode, all seeds/failures retained; freeze selected checkpoint hashes and selection rule before test
steps.excluded: Test-driven selection, reuse of P03 weights by assumption, old-science mutation

steps.name: Scientific PPO Benchmark
